declarations.description:
Geographical map with different terrain options including custom tiling, and GeoJSON support.

Keyboard: with `allowpanning` (and always in edit mode) the focused map pans with the arrow keys and zooms with + and -.
Pins are focusable and open their text on Enter. In edit mode a drawn shape is selected with Enter or Space, and its
handles move with the arrow keys. Touch: drag, pinch and tap work as on a mouse.
Layout: the map fills the width of the widget (down to 300 px) and follows its container when it is resized.
Files: GeoJSON (`.geojson`, `application/geo+json`) imports and exports; the export holds the overlay, the pins and the
drawn shapes, and an import of it restores them. The base layer, the view and the bounds are not part of the file.
Print: the toolbox and map controls are hidden, a vector map is printed as a copy of its current view, and the
titles of the pins are listed below the map.

members.name: initialPos
members.description:
Initial center position of the map.
Expected value: object { lat: number, lng: number } (e.g. { lat: 51, lng: 19 }).
Optional; when set via attribute, pass a JSON string (e.g. '{"lat":51,"lng":19}').

members.name: mapBounds
members.description:
Maximum bounding box for panning the map.
Expected value: Leaflet LatLngBoundsExpression (e.g. [[northLat, westLng], [southLat, eastLng]]).
Optional; when set via attribute, pass a JSON string (e.g. '[[51,6],[50,7]]').

members.name: maxZoom
members.description:
Maximum zoom level allowed when `boundsActive` is true.
Expected value: number (Leaflet zoom level).
Optional.

members.name: minZoom
members.description:
Minimum zoom level allowed.
Expected value: number (Leaflet zoom level).
Optional.

members.name: initialZoom
members.description:
Initial zoom level when the map is created.
Expected value: number (Leaflet zoom level).
Optional.

members.name: fixedZoom
members.description:
Fixed zoom level to enforce when panning is not allowed for viewers (non-edit contexts).
Expected value: number (Leaflet zoom level).
Optional.

members.name: markers
members.description:
Static pin markers to display on the map.
Expected value: array of { lat: number, lng: number, title?: string }.
Optional; when set via attribute, pass a JSON string.

members.name: objects
members.description:
Persisted drawing objects (rectangles, circles, polygons, polylines), keyed by id.
Expected value: map id -> { id, type, latlngs, radius?, borderColor, fillColor, borderOpacity, fillOpacity, label? }.
Optional; when set via attribute, pass a JSON string.

members.name: customTileUrl
members.description:
Custom tile URL template to use for the base map layer.
Expected value: string URL template containing {z}/{x}/{y}.
Optional; when empty, the default base layer is used.

members.name: vectorStyle
members.description:
MapLibre GL style URL for vector tile rendering (e.g. OpenFreeMap).
Expected value: URL to a MapLibre style JSON (e.g. 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty').
When set, this takes priority over customTileUrl and the default raster layers.

members.name: geoJSON
members.description:
GeoJSON overlay to render on the map.
Expected value: stringified GeoJSON (Feature or FeatureCollection).
Optional; when empty/falsy, no GeoJSON overlay is shown.

members.name: mapWidth
members.description:
Map container width, as a percentage of the host element's width.
Expected value: number (0–100). Applied as CSS width: `${mapWidth}%`.
Optional.

members.name: mapHeight
members.description:
Map container height in pixels.
Expected value: number (pixels). Applied as CSS height: `${mapHeight}px`.
Optional.

members.name: boundsActive
members.description:
Whether to enforce `mapBounds` and `maxZoom` constraints on the map.
Expected value: boolean; when true and `mapBounds` is set, panning is constrained to those bounds.
Optional.

members.name: resizeMap
members.description: Keeps the map filling its box when the widget is resized. The view keeps its center and is not stored as a new start position.

members.name: prepareImport
members.description: Reads and checks a whole GeoJSON file. Nothing changes before the returned function runs.

members.name: importGeoJSON
members.description: GeoJSON import of an action: the first file replaces the overlay, and replaces the pins and drawings too when the file holds them (nothing is merged).

members.name: exportGeoJSON
members.description:
Exports the overlay, the pins and the drawn shapes as one GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
Pins and shapes are tagged with a `kind` property, so that an import of the file restores them.
A circle is a point with a `radius` in meters; styles are kept as properties. Base layer, view and bounds are not part of it.

members.name: addPin
members.description: Opens the pin dialog for a pin at the center of the map.

members.name: renderMarkers
members.description: Draws the pins into one group, so that drawing them again never stacks duplicates.

members.name: selectShape

type.text: (map: L.Map, layer: WithId<T>, save: () => void) => L.Marker[]

members.description: Shows the handles of the selected shape. A selection by keyboard moves the focus to the first handle.

members.name: syncObjectAccess
members.description: Makes the drawn shapes reachable by keyboard: all of them for the author, the labelled ones for a reader who may move the map.
